title.value: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition
title.justification: The title captures the essence of the paper, which focuses on pooling methods using tensor decomposition in the context of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). The paper introduces a new GNN architecture called tensorized GNN (tGNN) that utilizes high-order pooling.
title.quote: High-Order Pooling for Graph Neural Networks with Tensor Decomposition

extractions.description: The paper introduces Tensorized Graph Neural Networks (tGNNs), a novel architecture that uses tensor decomposition to model high-order non-linear node interactions in graph neural networks. The tGNN architecture leverages the symmetric CP decomposition for efficient parameterization of permutation-invariant multilinear maps and demonstrates superior performance in node and graph classification tasks compared to existing methods.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on theoretical advancements and architectural improvements in Graph Neural Networks without directly addressing eco-responsible applications.
primary_category.quote: Though simple and effective, these linear operations do not model high-order non-linear interactions among nodes. We propose the Tensorized Graph Neural Network (tGNN), a highly expressive GNN architecture relying on tensor decomposition to model high-order non-linear node interactions.

secondary_categories.justification: While the paper itself does not focus directly on climate-related applications, GNNs are often used in domains such as social networks, recommender systems, and drug discovery, which can indirectly support climate-related innovations such as optimizing resources and improving efficiency in various systems.
secondary_categories.quote: As graphs are very general and flexible data structures and are ubiquitous in the real world, GNNs are now widely used in a variety of domains and applications such as social network analysis, recommender systems, graph reasoning, and drug discovery.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories listed do not match the core contributions of the paper regarding improvements in Graph Neural Networks architecture and pooling strategies.
primary_sub_category.quote: Experiments demonstrate that tGNN is more effective and accurate on 5 out of 10 datasets, showcasing the relevance of tensor methods for high-order graph neural network models.
